Welcome to the companion website for **EDUC 219-01: Schooling for Diverse Populations in American Society** at Howard University, taught by [Professor Nathan Alexander](https://professornaite.github.io){target="_blank"}.

This website provides supplementary course materials, module resources, selected documents, and links for our work throughout the semester. **Canvas is the official course site** for announcements, assignment submissions, discussion boards, due dates, and additional course materials.

[Visit the EDUC 219 Canvas site](https://canvas.howard.edu/courses/70108){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}
